title: A 25 bps hike: US Federal Reserve raises interest rates for first time since 2023
description: The US Federal Reserve increased interest rates by twenty-five basis points on Wednesday. This move aims to control inflation that remains significantly above the central bank's target. Consumer inflation stayed at three point four percent in August, prompting this necessary action. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh faces a significant test of his credibility with this decision. Analysts anticipate another rate increase in December, impacting financial conditions.

title: Sebi bars two entities over alleged cross-derivatives manipulation
description: India's market watchdog has intervened, prohibiting two companies for their role in stock derivative price manipulation. They reportedly employed advanced options and futures strategies to make significant profits, deliberately incurring losses in stock futures to sway option prices. The focus of this manipulation was notably on smaller-cap stocks, which are more susceptible to such tactics.

title: Morgan Stanley shifts $10 billion in municipal bond mutual funds to ETFs
description: Morgan Stanley is converting eight municipal bond mutual funds to ETFs. This move will transition nearly ten billion dollars in assets under management. The firm plans to launch seven new ETFs for these assets. Demand for municipal ETFs remains strong due to tax effectiveness and flexibility. These conversions are a defensive measure to retain client assets.

title: LIC, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs among anchor investors as NSE raises Rs 6,746 crore ahead of IPO
description: The National Stock Exchange of India secured Rs 6,746 crore from 189 anchor investors. Prominent participants included LIC, Morgan Stanley, and Goldman Sachs in this pre-IPO allocation. Shares were allotted to these investors at Rs 1,785 each, reflecting a significant premium. The NSE IPO, an offer for sale, is set to open for public subscription on September 17. This public offering aims to raise a total of Rs 22,561 crore.

title: UPDATE 1-J.B. Hunt shares tank as higher trucking costs prompt CFO's warning on possible profit drop

Other trucking firms also experienced share price declines following this news.  The company faces challenges with intermodal prices lagging behind rising operational costs.  Increased driver hiring and fuel expenses are impacting the trucking industry this year.

title: US stocks today: US stocks edge higher as oil eases ahead of Fed rate decision

Elevated Treasury yields and persistent inflation continue to pressure equity markets.
